about_the_game:
🍊 Welcome to Orange Life

You spawn into the world as... well, an orange. No explanation, no backstory — just you, your bouncy peel, and a strange ramp calling your name.

Climb it, and whatever you do — don’t stop at the top. A super sprint will launch you forward at insane speed. The laws of physics? Optional.

You also have a special ability: the Mega Jump. Press SPACEBAR to jump... and keep pressing. Each jump boosts your strength, letting you leap higher and higher like a juicy superhero.

Complete your first mission and earn the ultimate reward: a car.
It’s got first-person and third-person modes, a fuel system (don’t run out!), and full orange-powered movement.

Oh, and since you gathered all those oranges... you can now throw infinite oranges. For fun. Or chaos. Your choice.

🪂 Jump like a maniac.
💦 Avoid water (you can’t swim — you’re an orange, remember?).

No deep narrative. No complex systems. Just pure, ridiculous fun in a surreal open world.
Welcome to Orange Life

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains partial nudity with low-poly character models. Some characters may appear unclothed, but there is no sexual content or explicit depiction of genitalia.
